name: ROWMI
tagline: Playful tools with a lot of bark.
frame: 1px border + 2px hard drop, no glows, no gradients

logo.lockup: word at x=12 y=4 (chin line), 2 u clear space
logo.rule: whole steps only, never fractional u

motion.cursorGlide: 240ms spring, squash on landing, breathes while waiting
motion.pixelArtRule: whole pixels on 60Hz frame ticks; never scale, ease or fade

boot.screen: 64x40 dots, one dot per logo pixel

timeline.0: four claw taps start; the word steps down six rows per tap at 0/110/220/330ms
timeline.330: lands on the chin line with the fourth tap, one-dot bump
timeline.510: on the ring, all at once: Rommel alert with !, shell colour rises 4 rows per frame for 10 frames
timeline.900: app name in Silkscreen 24 under the lockup

rules: once per launch, never on focus or resume
any input after 300ms skips with a hard cut
never a loader: draw the app behind it; if not ready, hold the shell with the launch bar
reduced motion: finished screen for 800ms, keep the sound

rommel.rule: Idle is the logo. Other faces are reactions under a second, or states. Never decoration. One Rommel per screen. He reacts, never talks, never guilts.
rommel.onDark: stays black, tan and pink with a 1px Paper outline; never white

easterEgg.bubbles: type 'bubbles' or tap Rommel five times: bubbles rise for 7s, he grins and snaps at any that pass his mouth. Never on a timer, never blocks input.
